#!/bin/bash

    count=$(cat "$d"/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    pct=$(echo "scale=1; $count * 100 / $TARGET" | bc 2>/dev/null || echo "?")

    if ps aux | grep -v grep | grep "collect" | grep -qi "$(echo $name | cut -d_ -f1-2)"; then

done
